seller.coupon.page.intro: Creating a coupon only defines the distribution rules; coupons are actually issued when buyers claim them. "Issued" is how many were claimed, "redeemed" is how many were actually used in orders.
seller.coupon.page.noEditNotice: Coupon templates can't be edited: coupons already claimed keep the snapshot from when they were claimed, so changing the template only affects later claims. To adjust the rules, disable the old coupon and create a new one.

seller.coupon.list.confirm.stop.desc: Disable “{name}”? Buyers won't be able to claim it afterward, but coupons already claimed stay valid. There's no way to re-enable it here — to keep distributing, create a new one.
